basis: Ridge-regularised SRS from 120 completed games, home edge removed, margins capped at 30, rest days counted (0.25 per day of rest advantage), last season's rating adjusted for roster turnover (returning, departed and transferred players' box-score production), each team pulled toward last season with 4.2 games of weight, and each win probability blended 20% with a FiveThirtyEight-style Elo rating.
